request: Design a pressure hull for 5 crew.

text: Starting your 4000 m hull for five crew — I'll test a titanium sphere first.

problems: Too heavy to float: hull/displacement ratio 0.77 > 0.7

text: That sphere is too heavy to float, so I'll thin the wall to cut weight.

args.explanation: Titanium sphere 2.5m x 70mm. First try 80mm failed for buoyancy (weight ratio 0.77>0.7). Reduced to 70mm: passed with SF new 2.45, SF end-of-life 2.34, weight ratio 0.68, mass 6185kg. Titanium is fatigue-tolerant for 200 dives to 4000m (40.2 MPa).

text: CEO directive noted — I will test your 127 mm hull against the 4000 m mission life.
